spec_match.rationale: Applies source-verified rules: kInnerTextMinThresholdBytes=5 (EMPTY_TEXT/TEXT_TOO_SHORT), title prefix only with kClientSideDetectionIncludeTitleInInnerText and >5 bytes, ALLOWLISTED, MaxIntelligentScansPerDayDesktop=5, CGI-parameter stripping from csd.proto.

interactive.rationale: Presets, editable HTML and URL, ESB/allowlist/title/quota inputs; every change re-renders and re-evaluates.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Delivers hidden-text dropping, query stripping, 5-byte minimum, title prefix and quota as promised.

edge_cases.rationale: Near-empty page yields TEXT_TOO_SHORT; quota exhausted, allowlisted and ESB-off branches all reachable.

conformance.rationale: innertext-excludes-hidden-text assertion mirrors the extraction contract.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless google-chrome via Playwright (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this environment), desktop 1280x800 and mobile 360x740 DPR3 touch: every control clicked, live readouts changed as expected, zero console errors / page errors / failed requests, no horizontal overflow; screenshots Read. Scam sample: 79 bytes sent, hidden text dropped (textContent 173 chars); blank → TEXT_TOO_SHORT; quota 5 → EXCEED_QUOTA; allowlist → ALLOWLISTED.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts byte count consistency and that cloaked hidden text is excluded.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled controls and status outcome; the sandboxed frame has a title, but the checkbox inputs themselves are 22px inside 44px labels (label is the hit target).

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Two-column result collapses to one column at 360px; no overflow.

openQuestions.title: Renderer inner text vs HTMLElement.innerText
openQuestions.detail: Chrome collects inner text renderer-side; confirm it matches innerText for whitespace and form-control values before claiming byte-exact parity.

openQuestions.title: Fragment handling not stated
openQuestions.detail: csd.proto only says CGI parameters are stripped; the tool leaves the fragment untouched. Verify against source.

openQuestions.title: Inspect the accessibility tree with chrome-devtools-mcp
openQuestions.detail: Only DOM/labels were checked via headless Playwright; chrome-devtools-mcp was unavailable here (project rule 7b), so the a11y tree was not inspected.

openQuestions.title: No real Enhanced Safe Browsing run
openQuestions.detail: The server-side check itself cannot be triggered or observed from a page; nobody has confirmed end-to-end on an ESB-enabled Chrome 155 desktop profile that the documented triggers start an intelligent scan.

guidanceConsulted.query: sandboxed iframe srcdoc preview untrusted html
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Never insert untrusted HTML into the live DOM unsanitised; parse/sanitise or isolate it.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Exception-with-isolation: user HTML is rendered only in an iframe sandbox="allow-same-origin" (no allow-scripts) via srcdoc, because the demo must read the real rendered innerText (Sanitizer would alter what the page renders); scripts cannot run.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Sample containing hidden text rendered; no script execution; console clean.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive two column tool layout mobile no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep touch targets usable and content within its container on narrow viewports.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Grids use auto-fit minmax(min(100%, Nrem), 1fr); buttons min 44x44; wide content wraps or scrolls in labelled regions.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible form validation url input with live result
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use :user-invalid for styling only after interaction and sync aria-invalid with an aria-describedby error message.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: input:user-invalid border, aria-invalid set on failed submit and cleared on success, error text in aria-live element referenced by aria-describedby.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Playwright: bad input produced error text and aria-invalid=true.
